Mylar Bags quantity Add to cart Request a quote Category: Promotional Items Share: Description Reviews (0) Description Description Preserve, Protect & Present with Premium Mylar Bags Unmatched Protection for Sensitive Products If your product is sensitive to UV light, oxygen, or moisture, Custom mylar bags offer the perfect solution. Made from thick, food-grade PET, aluminum, and LDPE layers, these vacuum-sealed pouches act as a powerful barrier—keeping the contents fresh, dry, and protected during storage or transit. Whether you’re packaging pharmaceuticals, snacks, cosmetics, or dry ingredients, these bags provide commercial-level protection and unmatched durability.Eco-friendly kraft mylar bag option: Prefer a natural, paper-forward look? Choose our kraft mylar structures—an exterior kraft layer paired with a high-barrier inner film—to maintain low OTR/MVTR while reducing visible plastic and delivering a warm, sustainable aesthetic. For brands prioritizing end-of-life, we also offer foil-free high-barrier and mono-PE kraft-look films designed for simplified recycling (store-drop-off, where accepted). Custom Branding for Maximum Impact At PuffSticker, we offer full customization on Mylar pouches—letting you print your brand’s logo, colors, contact information, and product details right on the packaging. With crisp printing and a premium finish, these bags not only protect the product but also elevate your brand presence. Their reusable nature means customers will interact with your brand again and again, increasing long-term visibility and recall.On kraft: Your artwork pops on natural kraft with matte or soft-touch finishes. Request water-based/soy inks, low-VOC primers, and solventless lamination. Prefer the paper look with product visibility? Add a clear or frosted window without sacrificing barrier performance. Versatile & Industry-Proven Trusted across industries—from food and wellness to cosmetics and tech—our Mylar bags are ideal for both B2B and direct-to-consumer use. Their thick, puncture-resistant construction and airtight seal extend shelf life, reduce waste, and keep items safe. They’re an ideal choice for businesses that prioritize quality and sustainability.Kraft use cases: Coffee and tea (with optional degassing valves), artisanal snacks, botanicals, bath salts, powdered supplements, and refill packs all benefit from the kraft + high-barrier combo. For sustainability goals, we can explore aluminum-free barrier films and recyclable mono-PE kraft-look structures (availability varies by region). Customization Made Easy Our website offers a seamless web-to-print process—simply upload your design, select your preferred size, shape, and finish (matte, glossy, metallic, or even holographic), and we’ll take care of the rest. PuffSticker.com ensures fast turnaround and secure delivery so you receive high-quality barrier pouches ready to ship your product in style.Kraft Eco-friendly Mylar choices (quick guide): Structures: Kraft/PET/PE (workhorse), foil-free high-barrier kraft, or mono-PE kraft-look for store-drop-off programs where accepted. Formats: Stand-up (Doypack), side-gusset, flat, box-bottom; sample to bulk sizes. Features: Resealable zippers, tear notches, hang holes, rounded corners, clear/frosted windows, valves (coffee). Compliance: Food-contact safe inks/adhesives; batch coding support. Eco & Biodegradable Options — What’s Actually Green? 1) “Kraft Mylar” (paper/PET or paper/metallized PET/PE): Best for: Maximum barrier + natural kraft look. End-of-life: Typically not biodegradable or curbside-recyclable due to mixed layers. If recyclability is your target, choose our mono-PE kraft-look films designed for store-drop-off streams (where available). Why it’s eco-friendlier than standard foil: Lower aluminum usage (foil-free builds), solventless lamination, water-based inks, and lightweighting options to reduce material use. 2) Compostable “Kraft” Pouches (paper + compostable film): Materials: Kraft laminated to compostable biopolymers such as PLA/PBAT blends or cellulose-based films. Claims: Can be labeled “industrially compostable” when built and certified to standards (e.g., OK compost INDUSTRIAL / BPI). Performance: Great for dry goods and moderate shelf-life; lower heat tolerance and more moisture sensitivity than PET. For very oily, high-aroma, or long-shelf-life products, ask us to evaluate special coatings or consider a high-barrier recyclable path instead. End-of-life messaging: Use “Compostable in industrial facilities where accepted.” Home-compostable builds are possible but require specific structures and testing. 3) Recyclable “Kraft-Look” Mono-Material (PE): Look/feel: Paper-like print surface with kraft aesthetics; inner layer is single-resin PE for simplified recycling. End-of-life: Store-drop-off compatible in regions that accept PE films. Trade-offs: Excellent for recyclability goals; barrier can be very good with advanced coatings, but may not match full foil performance for extremely oxygen-sensitive products. 4) Bio-Based vs. Biodegradable vs. Recyclable — Know the Difference Bio-based = made partly from renewable inputs (e.g., corn, sugarcane) but may not be biodegradable. Biodegradable/Compostable = breaks down under specific conditions (often industrial compost); not necessarily recyclable. Recyclable = designed for mechanical recycling (e.g., mono-PE). Mixed laminates are usually not. Feature Add-Ons for Eco Builds Compostable zippers & valves: Available for select structures (coffee). PCR content: Add post-consumer recycled content to reduce virgin resin use (for recyclable builds). Inks & coatings: Water-based/soy inks, low-VOC primers, and vegetable-based overprints. Windows: Clear/frosted windows in compostable cellulose or recyclable PE; we’ll balance visibility and barrier. Lightweighting: Dial thickness to hit shelf-life targets with least material possible. Claiming It Right (Labeling Guidance) Use “Compostable in industrial facilities where accepted” for certified compostable builds. For recyclable mono-PE, use “Recycle if clean & dry—store drop-off where available.” Avoid blanket “biodegradable” claims on mixed laminates. We’ll help align your copy with certifications and regional rules to prevent greenwashing. Sustainability Note “Kraft mylar” refers to a paper/film laminate. Some builds aren’t curbside-recyclable everywhere. If maximum recyclability is your priority, we’ll recommend mono-PE kraft-look; if maximum barrier is required, we’ll suggest foil-free or metallized PET that balances performance with material efficiency. If your goal is biodegradability/compostability, we’ll guide you to certifiable compostable kraft structures best suited for dry goods and moderate shelf-life. Want a product-card blurb?Kraft Mylar Bags — Eco-forward look, serious protection. Choose recyclable mono-PE kraft-look, industrially compostable kraft laminates, or foil-free high-barrier paper/film. Options for water-based inks, solventless lamination, PCR content, windows, zippers, and coffee valves. They’re designed to block oxygen, moisture, and light, helping keep products fresher for longer while still presenting an eco-forward appearance. What can I package inside these Mylar bags? These bags are ideal for:Snacks and dry foodsCoffee and teaHerbs and botanicalsCosmetics, refills, or powdersThe barrier layers protect sensitive contents from environmental exposure. Are these bags recyclable or compostable? Depending on the configuration, you can choose recyclable mono-PE structures or certified compostable kraft laminates. End-of-life options (recyclable or compostable where accepted) will depend on local facilities and the laminate chosen. What customization options do kraft Mylar bags offer? Options typically include:Sizes (stand-up pouches, flat pouches, gusseted bags)Features such as zippers, tear notches, coffee valves, and windowsFull-color printing with low-VOC, water-based inksYou can match your brand identity while keeping the packaging functional. Are kraft Mylar bags heat-sealable? Yes. Custom Mylar bags are designed to be heat-sealed for tamper evidence and freshness. Whether for retail packaging, event giveaways, or everyday convenience, these stylish bags can be fully customized to fit your branding. Known for their abrasion and water resistance, these bags are ideal for everyday use and special occasions alike. Whether it’s rain or rough handling, these bags are built to hold up—without compromising on style. Endless Customization Possibilities PuffSticker.com offers extensive customization options to help your brand stand out. Choose from a wide range of colors, printing styles (CMYK, digital, screen printing), shapes, handle types, and structural designs. You can upload your logo, campaign slogan, or graphic design and see a preview before placing an order. Our intuitive web-to-print system makes it easy to create a nylon bag that truly reflects your brand identity. Multifunctional for Work, Travel & Promotion Nylon bags are multifunctional and appeal to a wide range of audiences. From tech-savvy professionals storing laptops and gaming devices, to students using them as school or college bags, to hikers and outdoor lovers needing lightweight, weather-resistant carry options—nylon bags are a universal favorite. They’re also perfect for promotional giveaways, conference swag, trade show merchandise, or retail branding. Eco-Friendly Reusability Meets Marketing Power These bags are not just long-lasting—they’re also reusable, offering sustainable value to eco-conscious customers. Every time someone reuses your branded nylon bag, your company name, slogan, and message travel with them—organically boosting brand visibility without spending extra on advertising. Reliable Quality & Quick Delivery At PuffSticker.com, we’re committed to delivering premium-quality synthetic fiber bags that meet your exact specifications. Our fast-turnaround times and secure, damage-resistant packaging ensure your order arrives on time and in perfect condition. Frequently asked questions Check out our frequently asked questions Why choose nylon bags for my brand promotions? Nylon bags are lightweight, weather-resistant, and durable, making them an excellent choice for reusable promotional items. They combine practicality with a modern look that appeals to a wide audience. Are nylon bags suitable for outdoor or all-weather use? Yes. Nylon is naturally resistant to light rain, splashes, and everyday wear, so these bags are great for outdoor events, travel, and daily commuting. They’re not fully waterproof for submersion, but they handle typical weather exposure well. Can I customize the size, color, and handles of nylon bags? You can typically choose from a range of sizes, bag shapes, handle styles (shoulder straps, drawstrings, etc.), and colors to match your brand palette. Your logo, slogan, or artwork can be added via CMYK printing on one or both sides. Are nylon bags comfortable to carry? Nylon fabric is soft and flexible, and when combined with well-designed handles or straps, custom nylon bags are comfortable for everyday carrying—whether for shopping, gym, or travel. How do I care for branded nylon bags? Spot clean with mild soap and water, then air dry. Avoid high-heat machine drying or harsh chemicals to preserve both the fabric and the printed design. acceptedAnswer.text: 3D labels are raised, dimensional stickers (often puffy, domed, or foam-based) that add depth and tactile interest to your logo or message. They instantly make products feel more premium and noticeable than flat labels.

mainEntity.name: What are 3D labels and how do they enhance branding?

acceptedAnswer.text: Flat stickers are a single layer of paper or vinyl, while 3D labels incorporate foam or resin layers to create thickness. This added dimension improves perceived value and makes your brand stand out on shelves or devices.

mainEntity.name: How are 3D labels different from regular flat stickers?

acceptedAnswer.text:
3D labels work well on:

  • Product fronts and packaging
  • Electronics and gadgets
  • Branded equipment and tools

Promotional items like cases or boxes
Just ensure the surface is smooth and clean for best adhesion.

mainEntity.name: Where can I apply 3D labels?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. With strong adhesive backings and protected print surfaces, custom 3D labels are built to withstand normal handling, bumps, and everyday use while maintaining shape and color.

mainEntity.name: Are 3D labels durable?

acceptedAnswer.text: PuffSticker prints with high-quality CMYK processes. If you provide Pantone references or brand guidelines, they’ll aim to match your colors closely within standard printing tolerances.

mainEntity.name: Can I match my brand colors accurately on 3D labels?

content.meaningfulText: Click to enlarge 3D Labels 3D labels feature a raised, puffy surface created with advanced three-layer printing—combining a strong adhesive backing, a vinyl base, and a UV or resin-coated top layer. acceptedAnswer.text: Epoxy stickers are vinyl decals coated with a clear epoxy resin that cures into a raised, glass-like dome. This protective layer enhances shine, depth, and durability, making them ideal for premium branding and product labeling.

mainEntity.name: What are epoxy stickers and how are they made?

acceptedAnswer.text: It comes down to the tactile “feel.” Epoxy stickers feature a hard, glass-like resin dome that is sleek and rigid. Puffy stickers use a foam-based material that is squishy and compressible. The choice depends on whether your brand requires a high-end, smooth finish or a soft, 3D texture.

mainEntity.name: How do Epoxy Stickers (Smooth Depth) differ from Puffy Stickers (Soft Depth)?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our 3D epoxy labels use a high-tack adhesive that bonds permanently to smooth, clean surfaces. They are ideal for metal, glass, plastic enclosures, and premium product packaging like custom Mylar pouches.

mainEntity.name: Which surfaces are best for 3D Epoxy Labels?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The cured epoxy coating adds protection against moisture, minor scratches, and general handling, helping your branding stay clear and glossy over time.

mainEntity.name: Are epoxy stickers waterproof and scratch-resistant?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our 3D resin is “self-healing.” Because the polyurethane material is slightly flexible, it can absorb minor impacts and “bounce back” to its original smooth shape. This keeps your branding looking pristine even on high-use items like laptops, mobile accessories, or industrial tools.

mainEntity.name: Will the 3D Resin coating scratch or dent over time?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. We specialize in custom shape epoxy stickers. We can precisely pour the resin to follow the specific contour of your logo or branding, whether it’s a simple geometric shape or a complex, specialized die-cut design.

mainEntity.name: Can I get epoxy stickers in custom shapes and sizes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We use high-grade polyurethane resin that is naturally waterproof and UV-resistant. Unlike cheaper alternatives, our epoxy stickers are designed to stay crystal clear without yellowing or cracking, even when exposed to direct sunlight and outdoor elements.

mainEntity.name: Do PU stickers have a matte or glossy finish?

acceptedAnswer.text:
The difference comes down to material, structure, and surface effect:

  • PU Embossed Stickers
    Built using a multi-layer construction, PU stickers have a matte, leather-like textured surface with a soft-touch feel. Selected areas can be raised in a convex, protruding form, creating a controlled, material-based depth rather than a glossy or exaggerated 3D effect.
  • Puffy Stickers
    Made using foam layers, they create a soft, thick, cushion-like 3D feel with more noticeable height and playful dimension.
  • 3D Epoxy Stickers
    Coated with a clear resin layer, they have a smooth, glossy dome finish that creates a high-shine, glass-like appearance with strong light reflection.

Each option offers a different tactile and visual experience, depending on whether the goal is subtle material depth, soft elevation, or high-gloss impact.

acceptedAnswer.text: Puffy sticker sheets feature multiple soft, raised puffy stickers on one sheet—often up to dozens of designs—making them ideal for collections, giveaways, and merch packs. Single puffy stickers usually feature one main design per piece.

mainEntity.name: What are puffy sticker sheets and how do they differ from single puffy stickers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Depending on sheet size and sticker dimensions, you can fit a variety of icons, characters, or logo variations on each sheet. Smaller designs let you include more stickers, while larger designs create bolder hero pieces.

mainEntity.name: How many designs can I include on one puffy sticker sheet?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Custom puffy sticker sheets are perfect for trade shows, school events, fan clubs, subscription boxes, and influencer packages. Each sheet offers multiple touchpoints with your brand in one compact product.

mainEntity.name: Are puffy sticker sheets good for events and giveaways?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. Many brands combine logo elements with themed illustrations, slogans, or mascots. This makes the sheet more collectible while still promoting your brand identity.

mainEntity.name: Can I mix branding and fun icons on the same sheet?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Sheets are flat, lightweight, and stackable, which makes them cost-efficient to store, pack, and ship globally—ideal for e-commerce orders and subscription boxes.

Puffy Sticker Sheets quantity Add to cart Request a quote Category: Puffy Labels & Stickers Share: Description Additional information Reviews (0) Description Description Custom Puffy Sticker Sheets – Soft, 3D Stickers for All Surfaces Custom puffy sticker sheets are a playful and engaging way to add personality to your brand, packaging, or projects. Each sheet features soft, raised stickers with a foamy texture and a bold, 3D look that instantly stands out. Printed in vibrant colors and die-cut with precision, these stickers combine tactile appeal with visual impact, making them more exciting than regular flat stickers. Available in a range of sizes and layouts, you can choose from pre-made templates or create your own custom design to match your unique style or branding needs. Features & Benefits What makes our puffy stickers special is their combination of durability, style, and versatility. Made from premium materials, these stickers maintain their vibrant colors and strong adhesive over time. Each sticker has a smooth, glossy or matte finish (your choice) and a raised texture that feels as good as it looks. With room for up to 40 stickers per sheet, they’re not just fun—they’re efficient too. Whether you’re ordering for personal use or business branding, these sheets are designed to leave a lasting impression. Popular Uses These custom sticker sheets are incredibly versatile and loved by people of all ages. Teachers use them to reward students, parents give them as gifts, and businesses rely on them for memorable marketing campaigns. They’re perfect for decorating laptops, water bottles, phone cases, notebooks, packaging, and more. Event planners and small brands use them in swag bags, gift boxes, and party favors. Crafters also love using them in journals, scrapbooks, and handmade cards to add a tactile, colorful element to their designs. Surface Compatibility Our puffy stickers are designed to stick securely to nearly any surface. Whether it’s metal, glass, plastic, or wood, these stickers adhere smoothly and stay in place without peeling. They’re ideal for customizing personal items like tech accessories, mirrors, notebooks, or craft materials, and they won’t lose their grip over time. The high-quality adhesive ensures they stay vibrant and in place—even with frequent use. Easy Ordering & Fast Delivery At PuffSticker.com, we make it easy to bring your sticker ideas to life. Whether you’re ordering a small batch or a large bulk run, our platform is simple to use, and turnaround times are quick. With low minimum order quantities, you can test designs or restock easily. We handle production and delivery with care so you can focus on creating and sharing your stickers with confidence. Why Choose Our Puffy Sticker Sheets We’re passionate about making high-quality, custom puffy stickers that people love. With a focus on vivid colors, raised textures, and user-friendly service, our goal is to help you make your designs stick—literally and emotionally. Whether you’re building a brand, hosting an event, or just adding a little fun to your day-to-day items, PuffSticker.com is your go-to destination for premium, customizable sticker sheets. Puffy sticker sheets feature multiple soft, raised puffy stickers on one sheet—often up to dozens of designs—making them ideal for collections, giveaways, and merch packs. Single puffy stickers usually feature one main design per piece. How many designs can I include on one puffy sticker sheet? Depending on sheet size and sticker dimensions, you can fit a variety of icons, characters, or logo variations on each sheet. Smaller designs let you include more stickers, while larger designs create bolder hero pieces. Are puffy sticker sheets good for events and giveaways? Yes. Custom puffy sticker sheets are perfect for trade shows, school events, fan clubs, subscription boxes, and influencer packages. Each sheet offers multiple touchpoints with your brand in one compact product. Can I mix branding and fun icons on the same sheet? Absolutely. Many brands combine logo elements with themed illustrations, slogans, or mascots. This makes the sheet more collectible while still promoting your brand identity. Are puffy sticker sheets easy to store and ship? Yes. Sheets are flat, lightweight, and stackable, which makes them cost-efficient to store, pack, and ship globally—ideal for e-commerce orders and subscription boxes. acceptedAnswer.text: Epoxy stickers are vinyl decals coated with a clear epoxy resin that cures into a raised, glass-like dome. This protective layer enhances shine, depth, and durability, making them ideal for premium branding and product labeling.

mainEntity.name: What are epoxy stickers and how are they made?

acceptedAnswer.text: It comes down to the tactile “feel.” Epoxy stickers feature a hard, glass-like resin dome that is sleek and rigid. Puffy stickers use a foam-based material that is squishy and compressible. The choice depends on whether your brand requires a high-end, smooth finish or a soft, 3D texture.

mainEntity.name: How do Epoxy Stickers (Smooth Depth) differ from Puffy Stickers (Soft Depth)?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our 3D epoxy labels use a high-tack adhesive that bonds permanently to smooth, clean surfaces. They are ideal for metal, glass, plastic enclosures, and premium product packaging like custom Mylar pouches.

mainEntity.name: Which surfaces are best for 3D Epoxy Labels?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The cured epoxy coating adds protection against moisture, minor scratches, and general handling, helping your branding stay clear and glossy over time.

mainEntity.name: Are epoxy stickers waterproof and scratch-resistant?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our 3D resin is “self-healing.” Because the polyurethane material is slightly flexible, it can absorb minor impacts and “bounce back” to its original smooth shape. This keeps your branding looking pristine even on high-use items like laptops, mobile accessories, or industrial tools.

mainEntity.name: Will the 3D Resin coating scratch or dent over time?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. We specialize in custom shape epoxy stickers. We can precisely pour the resin to follow the specific contour of your logo or branding, whether it’s a simple geometric shape or a complex, specialized die-cut design.

mainEntity.name: Can I get epoxy stickers in custom shapes and sizes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We use high-grade polyurethane resin that is naturally waterproof and UV-resistant. Unlike cheaper alternatives, our epoxy stickers are designed to stay crystal clear without yellowing or cracking, even when exposed to direct sunlight and outdoor elements.

acceptedAnswer.text: Faux leather labels are typically non-adhesive and used as sewn tags. PU stickers are adhesive-backed, allowing them to function as stickers while maintaining a leather-like appearance.

mainEntity.name: How are PU embossed stickers different from faux leather labels?

acceptedAnswer.text: They are water-resistant and suitable for everyday use, including light outdoor exposure.

mainEntity.name: Are embossed labels waterproof?

acceptedAnswer.text: PU stickers can be applied to a variety of surfaces including packaging materials, plastics, paper-based products, and certain fabrics, depending on the application.

mainEntity.name: What surfaces can PU embossed stickers be applied to?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, PU stickers can be die-cut into any custom shape and produced in a wide range of sizes based on your design requirements.

mainEntity.name: Can embossed stickers be customized in shape and size?

acceptedAnswer.text: PU embossed stickers feature a matte, leather-like finish with a fine grain texture, giving them a premium and refined appearance.

mainEntity.name: Do PU stickers have a matte or glossy finish?

acceptedAnswer.text:
The difference comes down to material, structure, and surface effect:

  • PU Embossed Stickers
    Built using a multi-layer construction, PU stickers have a matte, leather-like textured surface with a soft-touch feel. Selected areas can be raised in a convex, protruding form, creating a controlled, material-based depth rather than a glossy or exaggerated 3D effect.
  • Puffy Stickers
    Made using foam layers, they create a soft, thick, cushion-like 3D feel with more noticeable height and playful dimension.
  • 3D Epoxy Stickers
    Coated with a clear resin layer, they have a smooth, glossy dome finish that creates a high-shine, glass-like appearance with strong light reflection.

Each option offers a different tactile and visual experience, depending on whether the goal is subtle material depth, soft elevation, or high-gloss impact.

content.meaningfulText: Our Refund & Return Promise Every PuffSticker order is custom-made to your specifications. Because each product is produced specifically for you, we do not accept returns. However, if your order arrives with a production error or transit damage on our end, we will reprint it at no additional cost. 1. When You Are Eligible for a Free Reprint We will reprint your order at no charge if any of the following apply:The finished product differs materially from your approved design or uploaded artworkThe print quality is defective – for example, smudging, missing colors, or misaligned printingYou received the wrong product, size, or quantityYour order arrived damaged in transitAll reprint requests require photo evidence of the issue received. Claims must be submitted within 7 days of delivery confirmation. We are unable to process requests made outside this window. 2. When Reprints Are Not Offered The following situations fall outside the scope of our reprint policy, as they relate to customer-supplied artwork or decisions made prior to production:Files uploaded at low resolution or in an unsupported formatSpelling mistakes, design errors, or incorrect details present in customer-submitted artworkColor variation resulting from differences between screen displays and CMYK printing – minor variation is a normal characteristic of the printing processDelivery delays caused by an incorrect or incomplete shipping address provided at checkoutWe strongly recommend reviewing your artwork carefully before submitting. If you are unsure whether your files are print-ready, contact us before placing your order and we will advise. 3. How to Request a Reprint To submit a reprint request, please use our contact form and include the following:Your order numberA clear description of the issuePhotographs showing the problem with the product(s) receivedSubmit a reprint request via our contact form. We aim to respond to all reprint requests within 1–2 business days. 4. What Happens After Approval Once your reprint request has been reviewed and approved:The affected item(s) will be reprinted at no additional costProduction follows our standard turnaround timesReprints are shipped to your original delivery address using the same shipping method selected at checkoutWe will confirm approval and an estimated dispatch date by email. 5. Refunds Because all products are custom-made to order, we do not offer refunds as a standard resolution. In the rare circumstance that we are unable to fulfil an approved reprint request – due to production limitations or other exceptional reasons – we will contact you directly to discuss an appropriate resolution, which may include a store credit or a full or partial refund. 6. Questions If you have any questions about your order or this policy before submitting a claim, please contact our team. We are happy to help.
